title: IT Business Automation Intern - Technology IT
description: About Signant Health At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency. About The Role Signant Health is seeking IT Business Automation Interns: college students pursuing degrees in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, who want meaningful hands-on experience in enterprise software development. This is not a shadow-and-observe internship. Interns participate in real business projects alongside experienced engineers, receive structured mentorship from their first week, and contribute to development, testing, automation, and support work that real business teams rely on. The internship is deliberately designed around a student's academic life: part-time hours, a flexible schedule that accommodates college commitments, and a hybrid working model that concentrates in-person time where it matters most (onboarding, training, and team collaboration). The goal is a balanced experience: interns continue their college education while gaining genuine industry exposure, practical technical skills, mentorship, and professional development that a classroom alone cannot provide. Hybrid model: during the first 2 to 3 weeks, interns attend the office 2 days per week to support onboarding, training, team interaction, mentoring, and knowledge transfer. After the initial onboarding period, work is primarily remote, with occasional office attendance as needed. Shared office days: during onboarding, and for any office visits afterwards, all interns attend on the same days to maximize collaboration, mentoring, team engagement, and peer learning. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES - Function Participate in software development, testing, automation, and support activities on real business projects. Collaborate with team members on assigned projects and tasks, delivering work to agreed timelines. Participate in code reviews, team discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions. Create and maintain technical documentation for the features and processes you work on. Learn and apply software engineering best practices, including version control, testing, and deployment workflows. Gain exposure to Agile development methodologies and enterprise systems, participating in team ceremonies where schedules allow. Strong interest in software development, automation, cloud technologies, integrations, or enterprise applications. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Good communication and collaboration skills. Positive attitude and eagerness to learn in a professional environment. Ability to commit approximately 15 to 20 hours per week, and to attend the office on the shared office days during the onboarding period. Desirable: Academic, personal, or hackathon projects that demonstrate hands-on coding beyond coursework. Exposure to Git or another version control system. Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (for example, GitHub Copilot or Claude Code), or an interest in AI-driven automation. Apply the collaboration, code review, testing, and deployment practices used by professional engineering teams. Show strengthened problem-solving and analytical capabilities built through hands-on project work. Why Signant Health? At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission. We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo. title: AI Intern – Small Language Models (SLMs)
description: About Us: Join a team that is redefining the accessibility of space. Azista space is a transformative force in the global aerospace sector, uniquely positioned at the intersection of indigenous innovation and industrial scalability. Operating India’s first private-sector satellite mass-production facility in Ahmedabad, we have bridged the gap between complex engineering and high-volume manufacturing. As a vertically integrated leader, we provide end-to-end solutions from the precision design of satellite buses and advanced payloads to mission management and communication systems. We don’t just build hardware, we are democratizing the final frontier by providing global clientele with the cost-effective, high-performance technology needed to power the next generation of orbital missions. At Azista, you won't just be starting a job, you’ll be fuelling the future of space exploration. JOB SUMMARY In this role, you will take part in the hands-on development of Small Language Models (SLMs) tailored specifically for aerospace and space-sector applications, where compute, power, and connectivity are severely constrained and reliability requirements are mission-critical. Operating under the guidance of elite scientists from DRDO and ISRO alongside experienced industry experts, you will hold direct ownership of defined model modules from initial conception to working prototype. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Design, fine-tune, and evaluate small language models optimized for specialized aerospace and space-sector use cases. Collect, clean, and structure high-value domain-specific datasets sourced from complex technical documents, engineering specifications, industry standards, and mission data. Apply advanced model optimization techniques including quantization, distillation, and pruning to ensure seamless edge deployment in resource-constrained environments. Develop robust evaluation frameworks and custom benchmarks to measure model accuracy, operational reliability, and edge failure behavior. Implement and test retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and related knowledge-retrieval pipelines to enhance contextual precision. Maintain rigorous documentation of experimental runs, performance results, and architectural design decisions. Present weekly progress updates directly to veteran mentors and rapidly incorporate advanced technical feedback. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR? Currently pursuing or recently completed a B.Tech, M.Tech, or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, Aerospace Engineering, Electronics, or a closely related technical discipline. Strong programming proficiency in Python coupled with working knowledge of PyTorch or Hugging Face ecosystem libraries. Foundational understanding of transformer architectures and large language models, backed by a demonstrated ability to master complex concepts quickly. Exceptional analytical and problem-solving capabilities with meticulous attention to detail. A genuine passion for the aerospace, satellite, and space technology sector. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: Hands-on experience with parameter-efficient fine-tuning methodologies such as LoRA or QLoRA. Familiarity with RAG architectures, ONNX, GGUF, or embedded and edge deployment workflows. Proven track record through prior academic research, open-source contributions, or personal projects focused on NLP, LLMs, or aerospace systems. WHY JOIN US? PPO Opportunity: High-performing interns will be considered for a direct Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) to join our engineering core full-time. Elite Mentorship: Work shoulder-to-shoulder and receive direct mentorship from distinguished scientists from DRDO and ISRO alongside seasoned industry leaders. Pioneering Domain Ownership: Take full, end-to-end ownership of development work in a revolutionary, high-impact niche at the intersection of AI and aerospace. Mission-Driven Culture: Join a transformative force in the global aerospace sector where your code directly supports orbital missions and space democratization.

title: Data Engineering - Internship (Paid)
description: Every day, millions of shipments move around the world on data that nobody is looking at in real time. Orders, ASNs, invoices, and tracking events flow between 3PLs, forwarders, brands, and retailers, then get flattened into a status that tells you something went wrong only after it already has. SwiftB2B is an AI operating system for global supply chains. One platform where 3PLs, freight forwarders, brands, retailers, and manufacturers can see every item, shipment, and exception as it happens, and where the platform works out what a delay costs and starts the fix. We built it on 15 years of SwiftAnt’s EDI and supply chain work. We are a Databricks partner. What the internship is Six months on the data team, working on real pipelines that feed the product. You will not be building a toy project on the side. You will get a piece of the actual platform, with a mentor who reviews your work, and by the end you will have shipped something a customer’s data flows through. We pay, we give you Databricks Academy access and sponsor the Data Engineer Associate certification if you get there, and we often hire from this program. What you will work on Ingesting data from logistics systems (TMS and WMS exports, carrier APIs, EDI files like the 856 and 214) into Delta tables on Databricks. Writing PySpark and SQL transformations with data-quality checks that catch bad rows before they reach a dashboard. Building a small piece of our KPI catalogue end to end: source, model, test, documentation. Learning Unity Catalog, Lakeflow, and medallion architecture by using them, not by reading about them. Writing a runbook for what you built, so someone else can run it. What we are looking for Final-year students or recent graduates in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or anyone who has taught themselves and can show it. Python and SQL you have actually used on a dataset bigger than a CSV. Curiosity about how goods move around the world. You do not need logistics knowledge; you need to want it. You have built something with data, even a small thing, and can show us. How to apply Send a link to something you built with data: a repo, a notebook, a dashboard, a blog post. Two or three sentences on what was hard about it. That counts for more than your grades. If you have tried our online demo with your own data, tell us what you noticed. Equal opportunity SwiftB2B hires on talent, skill and curiosity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. If you need an adjustment at any stage of the process, tell us and we will make it happen.

title: DevOps / Cloud Engineering Intern (MLOps & AI/ML Exposure)
description: About the Internship VEGAH is looking for a DevOps / Cloud Engineering Intern with working exposure to MLOps and AI/ML to join our technology team. This is a hands-on developer role centered on cloud DevOps on Azure and AWS — building, automating, and operating the infrastructure and delivery pipelines that let data and machine learning workloads run reliably in production. As a secondary focus, you'll support MLOps workflows — experiment tracking, model packaging, and reproducible deployment pipelines. As a third focus, you'll get practical exposure to AI/ML by working with applied predictive analytics on structured enterprise data (payment delays, supplier delivery risk, customer behavior, service ticket escalation, and operational risk). You'll also develop full-stack awareness — understanding how services, APIs, and lightweight front ends fit together — and you'll be encouraged to use modern AI-assisted "vibe coding" workflows to move fast while keeping engineering quality high. This role suits someone who thinks in pipelines, infrastructure, and automation first — and is excited to apply those skills to machine learning systems. Work Schedule & Working Style (Mandatory) Must be available to work during USA CST (Central Standard Time) business hours. Readiness to work proactively and autonomously — you will be expected to take ownership of tasks, identify what needs doing, and drive work forward with minimal supervision. Be ready for impromptu meetings — the team works in a fast-moving environment where quick syncs, ad-hoc calls, and same-day discussions are common; you should be responsive and flexible. Comfortable operating with ambiguity, asking good questions early, and communicating progress clearly and frequently. Responsibilities Primary — DevOps & Cloud (Azure / AWS) Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) for application and ML workloads. Work with cloud services on Azure and/or AWS : compute, storage, networking basics, and managed services. Containerize applications and services (Docker) and support deployment and orchestration. Automate environment setup, configuration, and repeatable deployments (IaC basics — e.g., Terraform, Bicep, or CloudFormation). Support monitoring, logging, and operational reliability of deployed services. Use Git/GitHub workflows, branching, and code review practices. Secondary — MLOps Support experiment tracking (e.g., MLflow), model versioning, and reproducible training runs. Help package models into reusable components and deploy them through automated pipelines. Contribute to model/pipeline packaging and promotion across environments. Third — AI/ML Prepare and analyze structured datasets using Python (pandas, NumPy). Build and evaluate classification and regression models (scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost). Apply appropriate validation techniques and metrics; identify overfitting, class imbalance, and data leakage. Use explainability techniques such as SHAP where appropriate. Explore AutoML and newer approaches for tabular data. Cross-cutting — Full-Stack Awareness & Vibe Coding Build simple reusable Python components and APIs (e.g., FastAPI) and understand how they integrate with front ends and internal tools. Use AI-assisted development ("vibe coding") responsibly — leveraging AI tools to accelerate prototyping, refactoring, testing, and documentation — while reviewing and validating all generated code. Document experiments, infrastructure, results, and recommendations. Work with VEGAH subject-matter experts to translate business problems into technical use cases. Required Qualifications Working knowledge of Python and basic SQL. Hands-on familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure and/or AWS) — compute, storage, and basic networking concepts. Understanding of DevOps fundamentals : Git/GitHub, CI/CD concepts, containerization (Docker), and command-line tooling. Awareness of the AI/ML lifecycle — data preparation, training, evaluation, packaging, and deployment. Familiarity with pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn; understanding of basic classification/regression concepts. Must be available to work USA CST hours , with readiness for impromptu meetings. Demonstrated ability to work proactively and autonomously — self-directed, ownership-oriented, and comfortable with ambiguity. Strong communication skills and responsiveness in a fast-paced, distributed team. Ability to learn new tools and platforms independently. Openness to AI-assisted development workflows with sound engineering judgment. Preferred Qualifications Experience with one or more of the following is helpful but not required: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or other CI/CD tooling Terraform, Bicep, or CloudFormation (IaC) Kubernetes or container orchestration basics MLflow, model registries, or MLOps tooling XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, AutoGluon, SHAP FastAPI and REST API development Light full-stack exposure (simple web front ends, dashboards, integrations) Kaggle or personal projects spanning cloud, DevOps, or ML Students or recent graduates in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cloud Computing, DevOps, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or related quantitative disciplines are encouraged to apply. Previous SAP experience is not required. What You Will Work On Your initial assignment will involve standing up the cloud and CI/CD foundations for benchmarking machine learning approaches against several structured enterprise-data prediction scenarios on Azure/AWS — automating training and evaluation runs, tracking experiments, and packaging the strongest candidates into deployable services with reproducible pipelines. The objective is to demonstrate which approaches provide the best combination of predictive performance, explainability, development effort, and operational simplicity — and to prove it with automated, cloud-deployed, shippable code. Strong performers may be considered for future opportunities with VEGAH based on business needs and performance.
